head: WhatsApp sound stickers in testing: stickers that play audio on tap
dek: WhatsApp is testing stickers with sound in its Android beta 2.26.41.3, according to WABetaInfo: you turn a video into a sticker and keep its audio, record a voice note or add a sound file from your phone. WhatsApp hasn't said when, or whether, everyone gets it.
details: The sound plays only when the person who gets the sticker taps it; until then it stays silent, and a small audio icon shows that it has sound. To make one, testers open a chat, tap the sticker icon, choose Create sticker, pick a video and tap the new Sound icon at the top. The sound editor works with normal stickers too. Not every beta tester has it yet.
where: Some WhatsApp beta testers on Android
means: If you get this later, stickers can carry a voice note or a short sound, and nothing plays unless you tap it.
todo: Nothing to do yet. Android users who want to try features early can join WhatsApp's beta through Google Play.
